result.title: CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification
result.summary: Automated identification of individual animals is moving from small curated studies toward shared benchmarks and reusable foundation models. This progress is useful, but current evaluation leaves the evidence behind a match unresolved, i.e., high retrieval accuracy does not show whether a model used animal features or identity-correlated shortcuts. We address this with Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval (CFR), an evidence-aware evaluation protocol. CFR evaluates the same query-gallery task under different views: full image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only. The full-image measures standard retrieval performance; the foreground-only measures foreground-supported retrieval; and shortcut-only view measure how much identity signal is recoverable from background, or silhouette. This turns a retrieval score into an evidence profile: how well the model performs on the original images, how much of that performance remains when only the animal is visible, and how much identity signal remains recoverable when the animal is removed. We release around 0.5M masks for 34 datasets and code for mask generation and CFR evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CounterFactual Foreground Retrieval（CFR）评测协议，在同一 query–gallery 检索任务下分别用全图、仅前景、仅捷径（背景或轮廓）三种视图考察匹配所依据的证据，把单一检索分数转成「证据画像」，并发布约 0.5M 掩码覆盖 34 个数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用反事实视图把任务相关视觉证据与捷径分开考察的评测思路，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真的依赖实体与前景细节、以及视觉旁路与信息坍缩的诊断设计；但研究对象是个体动物检索而非 VLM 推理，迁移需较多核查。
